title: Unramifiedness tested on geometric fibres for a locally finite type morphism
statement: Let $h:Z\to B$ be a morphism of schemes locally of finite type [def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. For each point $s\in B$, let $\kappa(s)$ be its residue field [def-weil-residue-field], choose an algebraic closure $\overline{\kappa(s)}$, and let $h_{\bar s}:Z\times_B\operatorname{Spec}\overline{\kappa(s)}\to\operatorname{Spec}\overline{\kappa(s)}$ be the geometric fibre morphism [def-weil-geometric-fibre]. Then $h$ is unramified [def-weil-unramified-morphism] if and only if every $h_{\bar s}$ is unramified. Empty geometric fibres are allowed. No flatness, finite presentation, quasi-compactness, or Noetherian hypothesis on $B$ is assumed.
